task:
Build a simple Ticket feature that integrates into the existing Telegram bot (aiogram 3), following all existing code conventions exactly. ABANDON the complex approach (web admin panel, /new_ticket bot commands, separate data layer). The bot is a basic Telegram bot — there is no web frontend. The 'homepage' is the main menu shown after /start (app/bot/routers/common.py), and the 'admin panel' is the inline-keyboard menu shown after /admin (app/bot/routers/admin/menu.py).

IMPLEMENTATION SPEC:

1. DATABASE (new migration v11 in app/db/migrations.py):
   - tickets table: id, owner_id (FK users), subject (TEXT), priority (TEXT default 'normal': low/normal/high), status (TEXT default 'open': open/in_progress/resolved/closed), created_at, updated_at
   - ticket_messages table: id, ticket_id (FK tickets), sender_id (Telegram user id), sender_role ('user'/'admin'), body (TEXT), created_at
   - Owner-scoped access: users see only their tickets; admins see all.

2. USER FACING (main menu):
   - Add a '🎫 التذاكر' button to the main menu in app/bot/keyboards.py main_menu() and app/bot/callbacks.py (add MenuCB action 'tickets').
   - New router app/bot/routers/tickets.py with handlers:
     - List user's own tickets (open/in_progress) with inline buttons to open each ticket.
     - Create ticket flow: ask for subject (one message), then message body (one message), then confirm. Use FSM StateGroup TicketFSM in states.py.
     - View ticket detail: show subject, status, priority, full message thread (user messages right-aligned, admin messages left), and a '↢ رجوع' back button.
   - Add '↢ تذاكري' reply button so users can reply to admin messages on a ticket (same flow: ask for message body, then confirm).
   - Register the new router in app/bot/__init__.py build_dispatcher (before common.router, like other feature routers).
   - Add a MenuCB action 'main' handler for the tickets back-button.

3. ADMIN FACING (admin panel after /admin):
   - Add a '🎫 التذاكر' button to the admin menu in app/bot/routers/admin/keyboards.py admin_menu_kb() and callbacks.py (new constant TICKETS).
   - New router app/bot/routers/admin/tickets.py with handlers:
     - List all tickets with status filter buttons (كل التذاكر / مفتوحة / قيد المعالجة / منتهية).
     - View ticket detail: subject, status, priority, full message thread, and action buttons: change status (dropdown via inline buttons), set priority (low/normal/high), reply to user (sends a bot DM to the ticket owner via bot.send_message), close ticket.
     - Use the same admin callback pattern (string constants with PREFIX in callbacks.py).
   - Register the new admin router in app/bot/routers/admin/router.py (include_router before menu).

4. TEXTS (app/bot/texts.py):
   - Add Arabic button labels: BUT_TICKETS = '🎫 التذاكر' (main menu), BUT_TICKET_DETAIL = '↢ تذكرة' (admin), BUT_CLOSE = '× إغلاق', etc.
   - Add Arabic message templates: M_TICKETS_TITLE, M_TICKETS_EMPTY, M_TICKET_CREATE_SUBJECT, M_TICKET_CREATE_BODY, M_TICKET_CREATED, M_TICKET_NOT_FOUND, M_TICKET_STATUS_OPEN, etc.
   - Add render_ticket_card(job) or render_ticket_detail(ticket, messages) renderers following the existing render_* pattern.
   - Add ticket_status_label() and ticket_priority_label() functions.
   - All Arabic text, HTML parse mode, esc() for user content. No emoji in user-controlled strings, only in pre-defined Arabic UI text (matching existing pattern where existing buttons use icons like 🎫 👥 📊 etc).

5. REPOSITORIES (app/db/repositories.py):
   - create_ticket(db, owner_id, subject, priority='normal') -> ticket_id
   - list_user_tickets(db, owner_id) -> list
   - list_all_tickets(db, status_filter=None) -> list
   - get_ticket(db, ticket_id, owner_id=None) -> ticket or None (admin can pass None)
   - create_ticket_message(db, ticket_id, sender_id, sender_role, body) -> message_id
   - list_ticket_messages(db, ticket_id) -> list
   - update_ticket_status(db, ticket_id, status)
   - update_ticket_priority(db, ticket_id, priority)
   - set_ticket_updated(db, ticket_id)

6. TESTS: Add tests covering repository functions (ticket CRUD), text rendering, and ticket status/priority labels. Follow existing test patterns in tests/.

7. NO CHANGES to the existing transfer flow, accounts, jobs, or admin broadcast/stats/notifications features. This is an isolated, additive feature.
